role: skeptic #2 — attempted refutation of a claimed LOW-severity a11y contrast finding
verdict: REFUTED = false (claim HOLDS; every number reproduced exactly and independently)

claim.title: AdminLessonBuilder contrast: white on raw bg-accent 4.23:1, text-white/40 3.61:1, text-foreground/40 2.35:1

independence.note: Ratios were reproduced three ways: (a) independent WCAG math in Python, (b) live DOM via Playwright MCP, (c) live DOM via Chrome DevTools MCP page 11. All three agree to 2 decimals.
independence.no_probe_artefacts: No 429 involved (rate_limit:* buckets flushed before probing; global bucket is 100/min/IP). No scrollbar metric used. Route confirmed to have rendered the builder, not a guard redirect: document h2 = 'Xây Dựng Bài Học', tile present, both delete buttons present with aria-labels.

measurements.element: logo/monogram tile span.text-white on the tile background

as_at_HEAD.verdict: FAIL (1.4.3 normal text; 14px/900, not large text)

measurements.element: section delete control button[aria-label='Xóa section 1'] — class text-white/40
block delete control button[aria-label='Xóa block 1'] — class text-foreground/40

root_cause_verified.claim: v11 F132 migrated buttons to --geo-accent-strong but this logo tile kept the raw bg-accent; the two close/remove controls use 40% opacity.
root_cause_verified.evidence: git show 30bc9b6 -- frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLessonBuilder.vue migrated THREE bg-accent usages in this same file (save-error badge, AUDIO badge) to bg-accent-strong and changed hover:text-accent -> hover:text-accent-ink, but did NOT touch line 6's tile (still raw bg-accent at HEAD) nor the base text-white/40 and text-foreground/40 opacities. design-system.css:702-704 carries the F132 comment: 'white on #8B5CF6 measured 4.23:1 (needs 4.5:1). --geo-accent-strong is 5.70:1.'

refutation_attempts_that_failed: Probe artefact (429): no — ratios are deterministic from static tokens; independently recomputed in Python and reproduced live in two browsers.
Scrollbar false positive: not applicable — this is a colour-contrast measure, no geometry involved.
Guard redirect misread as failure: no — builder actually rendered (h2 + tile + both aria-labelled buttons present).

WCAG 1.4.3 'logotype' exemption for the 'B' tile: the real EngFlow brand mark is in AdminLayout.vue (3-shape mark + 'EngFlow' wordmark). This tile is a decorative monogram, is NOT aria-hidden, and sits beside an h2. Even granting the exemption, the finding stands on the two × controls, which are unambiguously 1.4.3 failures.
'Icon-only control, so exempt': no — the × is text content in a button; 1.4.3 applies. The block × additionally fails 1.4.11 at 2.35 (needs 3.0).
correct_behaviour_check: Not correct behaviour — a genuine contrast defect. Reproduced live at both pre-fix and post-fix states.

severity.assessment: JUSTIFIED. Admin-only, icon-only controls each carrying an accessible name (aria-label), so the visual glyph is a supplementary affordance. The block × at 2.35:1 is the worst of the three (fails 1.4.3 and 1.4.11), but LOW remains appropriate — not overstated.

live_verification.deployed_state_measured: FIXED working tree (unstaged): tile bg-accent-strong 5.70:1; section × text-white/60 6.23:1; block × text-muted-foreground 6.38:1
